scope.summary: Author the muscle channel group per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-048), closing REQ-015: per muscle group, three separate axes — muscle_mass_* (geometry via multi-key tracks), muscle_definition_* (detail-map weight consumed by the 13.22 skin stack, no geometry), and flexion state (pose-driven hook resolved by the 13.19 corrective engine). Mass without definition and definition without mass must both be dialable.
acceptance_criteria: Per-group channels registered for at least: pecs, delts, traps, lats, abs, biceps, triceps, quads, hamstrings, calves, glutes-muscle — each as muscle_mass_<group> (Tissue, geometry track over the group mask) and muscle_definition_<group> (Tissue, zero-geometry detail-map weight; registry row flags map_weight_only=true).
muscle_definition_* channels produce exactly zero vertex displacement at any value (map-weight-only proof) and export a typed DetailMapWeightHook for the 13.22 skin stack.
Flexion is registered as a typed pose-driven hook contract (FlexionHook: bone rotation source -> corrective activation) resolved by 13.19; no direct flexion channel writes geometry in this MT.
Independence test: muscle_mass_pecs at max with muscle_definition_pecs at 0, and the inverse, both evaluate correctly (mass-without-definition / definition-without-mass).
Full-range mass sweeps pass BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID per group mask; muscular male sample (archetype f basis) with all mass channels at 100% evaluates artifact-free.
scope.risk_if_missed: Collapsing mass/definition/flexion into one dial (the Daz Musculature-pack shortcut) makes muscular archetype (f) unreachable at production quality — definition without mass is needed for lean builds, and pose-driven flexion belongs to correctives, not static morphs.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
